        Miva Open University - We are an education company building a new kind of university targeted at the African region. Miva, a subsidiary of the uLesson Group, is a Pan-African Distance e-Learning University that is built on a couple of beliefs:
     

            
    



Firstly, we believe that the traditional brick-and-mortar approach to tertiary education is no longer a viable option for serving learners on the African continent. This approach will not provide the capacity and efficacy for the people of the region. We are building a university experience that leverages excellent academic talent (wherever it is to be found) and digital technologies to create a new, fresh, more efficacious and more accessible tertiary experience. Our second belief is that this new tertiary experience must not only meet but exceed the existing way of doing things in terms of quality, efficacy and preparing learners for the future.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Facility Officer
Job Locations: Akwa Ibom, Kaduna, and Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Summary


	The Facility Officer will be responsible for the effective day-to-day management, maintenance, safety, and operational readiness of the Study Centre.
	The role will ensure that the facility provides a safe, functional, welcoming, and conducive environment for students, employees, visitors, and other stakeholders.
	The Facility Officer will also coordinate renovation and fit-out activities where required, manage contractors and service providers, oversee utilities and maintenance, ensure compliance with health and safety requirements, and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and optimize facility-related costs.


Responsibilities


	Oversee renovation, furnishing, fit-out, and setup activities, ensuring completion in line with approved requirements, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
	Manage the day-to-day maintenance and upkeep of the Study Centre, including electrical, plumbing, air-conditioning, furniture, fixtures, and other facility infrastructure.
	Coordinate and supervise contractors, vendors, technicians, and other service providers, ensuring timely and satisfactory delivery of services.
	Conduct routine facility inspections, identify maintenance requirements, and ensure repairs and faults are promptly addressed to minimise operational disruptions.
	Ensure the Study Centre is clean, functional, and appropriately prepared for daily operations, academic activities, meetings, examinations, and events.
	Implement and enforce health, safety, security, and environmental procedures, including regular safety inspections, risk assessments, and emergency response plans.
	Monitor electricity, water, fuel, and other utilities and implement initiatives to reduce consumption and facility-related costs without compromising service quality.
	Optimise the use and layout of classrooms, offices, common areas, and other spaces to support current and future operational requirements.
	Maintain accurate records of facility assets, maintenance activities, vendor services, utility consumption, and related expenditure.
	Identify and implement opportunities to improve facility processes, operational efficiency, service delivery, and cost-effectiveness.
	Liaise with relevant internal teams to ensure facility-related requirements and issues are addressed promptly.
	Perform any other duties as may be assigned by the supervisor or management.


Requirements


	Possess a Bachelor's Degree or HND in Facility Management, Estate Management, Building Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field with 3 – 5 years of relevant experience in facility management, building operations, property management, or a related role.
	Experience managing contractors, vendors, maintenance activities, and facility improvement projects.
	Working knowledge of health and safety requirements, building maintenance, utilities management, and basic facility systems.
	Strong organisational, problem-solving, vendor management, and cost-management skills.
	Good communication, interpersonal, reporting, and record-keeping skills.
	Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and respond promptly to operational issues.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and / or Google Workspace.

  "title": "Project Engineer & Scrum Master",
  "description": "Codelabprojects is an AI-first technology and services company delivering intelligent and scalable solutions across multiple sectors. Our capabilities span Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Software-as-a-Service (SaaS), Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS), Mobility-as-a-Service (MaaS), Data-as-a-Service (DaaS), energy solutions, and AI-enabled operational systems.

We focus on building innovative digital products, optimizing business operations through technology, and enabling organizations to leverage artificial intelligence, data, and modern digital platforms to operate more efficiently and competitively.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:&nbsp;

&nbsp;Job Position: Project&nbsp;Engineer &amp; Scrum Master

Job Location: Sabon-Lugbe, Airport Road - Abuja (FCT) ,
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: On-site

Role Overview


	Codelabprojects Nigeria Limited is seeking an experienced and results-driven Project Engineer &amp; Scrum Master to coordinate and oversee the successful planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of technology, engineering, digital, operational, and client-related projects across the organization.
	The successful candidate will serve as a key link between Management, project teams, technical teams, clients, vendors, and other stakeholders.
	The role is responsible for ensuring that project objectives are clearly defined, tasks are properly assigned, blockers are resolved, timelines are maintained, and deliverables are completed to the required standard.
	The ideal candidate should have strong project management, technical coordination, problem-solving, and leadership capabilities, together with practical knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies. While software and technology projects may form part of the portfolio, the role is not limited to software development and will require the ability to coordinate different types of projects across the organization.
